decisions.reason: The XL package for the anamnesis app is a low-cost pricing tier on existing software that keeps open the option to serve large practices and dental chains as consolidation grows, so there is no reason to abandon it while demand is still being revealed.

The dedicated support service for dental assistants builds on the firm's core strength in customer service, costs little to maintain, and has its own page signaling commitment, so keeping the option open is clearly preferable to dropping it after only one year.
